verdicts.title: Recent replays keeps only 3 (3D) or 4 (2D) full-length matches, not the 5 advertised, and replay codes are 65-81 KB, too long to paste into most chats
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this in my own worktree at /tmp/rt/replays-verify/repo (derby/main c59a889). The impact is smaller than the other reviewer claimed: 3 or 4 replays are kept, not 2 or 3.

What I ran and saw:
- Bun, repo's scripted() bot, real HALF_SECONDS=180 (/tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/size.ts). Every tick is its own run (runs == ticks, 22000-23260 ticks) at 5.01 chars/tick. Codes are 110,204-116,582 chars, and addRecent kept 2 of 5. This bot sets more flags than a real player does, so its numbers are too high.
- Bun, a cursor-following-the-ball bot (same script): 4.1 chars/tick, codes 94-100K, kept 3 of 5. With halfSeconds=60, as tests/replay.test.ts:370 uses, all 5 are kept (JSON 196K). So the test 'real replays: five fit well under the cap' (tests/replay.test.ts:367) passes only because its matches are a third of real length.
- Browser, real full-length ranked match with no half override, mouse moving like a human (/tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/fullmatch.cjs):
  - 3D: 81,352 chars for 22,368 ticks (3.64/tick).
  - 2D: 66,459 chars for 22,361 ticks (2.97/tick). The result dialog shows 'CODE 65 KB' (/tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/result-2d.png).
  - 3D with the mouse never moving (shortmatch.cjs, 20 s halves): about 2.6 chars/tick after the 1.2 KB header. The world cursor changes almost every tick even when the hand is still, because input.ts:337-343 re-projects the pointer through the moving broadcast camera every tick and runs it through the One Euro filter. That breaks the run-length coding.
  - The header alone is about 1.2 KB (header.ts). A pointer that never moves in world space gives 1,278 chars for a whole match, so the size is all per-tick runs.
- What that means for the cap: KEEP_CHARS = 300_000 is at src/meta/replay.ts:750, not 723.
  - 3D, the default renderer: 3×81.4K = 244K fits, 4× = 326K does not, so 3 are kept.
  - 2D: 4 are kept.
  - The level perks scale the cap by slot count (src/client/replayStore.ts:42). 'Replay shelf of 8' (level 40) then holds about 5, and the shelf of 10 (level 65) about 7.
- What the game promises:
  - README.md:85 (not 75) says 'The last five replays are kept' and 'a short `OVR1.…` string'. The real prefix is DD1. and OVR1. is a legacy prefix.
  - The empty state at src/client/replayView.ts:66 says 'Your last 5 matches are kept here'.
  - docs/ROADMAP.md:30 still says '2×2-minute match ... about 39 KB'.
  - An 81 KB code is over WhatsApp's 65,536-character limit and Slack's 40K. replayView.ts:149 says 'send it to a friend'.

Why I downgraded it from major to minor: no match or core flow breaks. The shelf holds fewer replays than it promises and the perks give less than they say.

Root cause: writeRuns (src/meta/replay.ts:519-565) writes at least 3 bytes for every tick whose cursor changed, and in 3D that is almost every tick. The bytes are not compressed, and the 300K cap was sized from the 60 s test.

Fix:
(1) In src/meta/replay.ts:750, size KEEP_CHARS from real codes: about 100K per slot, so 500_000 for 5. Or store each replay under its own localStorage key so one big code never pushes out another.
(2) Make codes smaller with a REPLAY_VERSION bump. Coarsening the cursor alone barely helps: at 5 cm the raw body only drops from 78K to 69K bytes, because a 1-byte flag and two deltas are still written every tick. Deflating the body is what works. Bun.deflateSync on the same body gives 31.5K bytes (about 42K chars) at 1 cm and 16.4K bytes (about 22K chars) at 5 cm. Browsers have CompressionStream('deflate-raw'), so this adds no dependency. Alternatively, pack the flag and a small delta into one byte.
(3) In tests/replay.test.ts:370, use HALF_SECONDS and a cursor that changes every tick.
(4) Fix README.md:85 (the 'short' claim and the OVR1. prefix) and docs/ROADMAP.md:30. Consider offering sharing as a file download or link alongside the text code.

verdicts.title: Landscape phone: the match uses under half the screen width, and on short viewports the HUD overlaps itself
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with my own script, /tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/phone.cjs (isMobile, hasTouch, deviceScaleFactor 2, ranked match, 3D and 2D).

Measured #pitch boxes [left, top, width, height] in css px:
| Viewport | 3D | 2D | Share of screen |
|---|---|---|---|
| 844x390 | [215,20,413,277] | identical | 49% of width, 35% of area |
| 932x430 | [229,20,475,318] | | 51% of width |
| 844x340 (browser toolbars) | [254,20,337,226] | | 40% of width, 27% of area |
| 1280x800, for comparison | | | 81% of width, 71% of area |

There are 215 px dead bands left and right (screenshots /tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/phone-3d-844x390.png and phone-2d-844x390.png). In 2D the player numbers cannot be read.

At 844x340 it looks broken, not just cramped (phone-3d-844x340.png):
- The score bar runs under 'Esc MENU': .hud-tl ends at x=509 and .hud-tr starts at x=478.
- The 66 px Pass button sits on the radar: radar right edge 472, Pass left edge 438.
- The zoom buttons cover the power bar.
The HUD uses its desktop sizes here (21 px score, 100 px radar) because the compact rules at hud.css:95 only apply at max-width 640px, and landscape phones are wider than that.

Root causes:
(a) src/client/hud.css:2 sets `.match .pitch-wrap { width: min(100%, calc((100vh - 120px) * 1.531)) }`. On a phone in landscape that reserves 120 px of a 390 px screen, and #app adds 20 px at the top. The canvas is also locked to aspect-ratio 112/75 (src/client/styles.css:615), and the only override is portrait-only (hud.css:113-116).
(b) The touch hint is meant to be hidden on touch screens (styles.css:651, `.controls-hint { display: none }` under pointer: coarse). But hud.css:122, `.controls-hint.clamp { display: -webkit-box }`, has higher specificity, so the hint still shows under the pitch (#controls-hint measured at [16,307,812,20]).
(c) The compact HUD rules key on width only.
There is no requestFullscreen or landscape handling anywhere in src.

I checked the fix. I injected this CSS (/tmp/rt/replays-verify/out/phonefix.cjs):
`@media (pointer: coarse) and (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px) { #app { padding: 0 } .match { gap: 0 } .match .pitch-wrap { width: 100% } #pitch.pitch-3d { aspect-ratio: auto; height: 100dvh; border-radius: 0 } .controls-hint, .controls-hint.clamp, .hint-more { display: none } }`
The 3D canvas became 812x390 (2.8 times the area), and the renderer handled the wide aspect correctly (phonefix-844x390.png). About 30 px of vertical scroll is left over (scrollHeight 420) and needs clearing.

Suggested fix:
1. In hud.css, add that landscape rule. For 2D, use width: min(100%, calc(100dvh * 1.493)).
2. Extend the compact HUD block at hud.css:95 to `(max-width: 640px), (pointer: coarse) and (max-height: 500px)`.
3. Optionally move Pass/Shoot into the safe-area side bands (styles.css:646).
4. Change styles.css:651 to `.controls-hint, .controls-hint.clamp { display: none }`.
5. Only after that, optionally call requestFullscreen on the first touch in src/client/matchView.ts. Orientation lock through a manifest is PWA work (PR #5), but this layout fix is not.
